import sys

class DS:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.cont = [1] * n
        self.cc = 0

    def SetOf(self, x):
        if self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.SetOf(self.parent[x])
        return self.parent[x]

    def Merge(self, x, y):
        x = self.SetOf(x)
        y = self.SetOf(y)
        if x == y:
            return False
        if self.cont[x] > self.cont[y]:
            x, y = y, x

        self.cc += (self.cont[x] == 1 and self.cont[y] == 1)
        self.cc -= (self.cont[x] > 1 and self.cont[y] > 1)

        self.parent[x] = y
        self.cont[y] += self.cont[x]
        return True


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    mod = 10**9 + 7
    ans = 1

    if k == 0:
        ans = pow(p, p - 1, mod)
    else:
        cc = p
        ds = DS(p)
        for i in range(p):
            if ds.Merge(i, (k * i) % p):
                cc -= 1

        if k > 1:
            cc = ds.cc
        ans = pow(p, cc, mod)

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
